title: Explicit authored orders and dimensional arithmetic
limitations: Scenario amounts and orders are fictional inputs, not treatment recommendations. No external conversion needed for minutes/hours.

title: RDaSH ECT clinical guidelines policy
locator: Recovery monitoring; physical observations; memory and cognition during treatment
support: Supports post-anesthetic monitoring and continued cognition assessment.
limitations: The t1_02 numeric reassessment trigger is an explicit fictional unit rule, not an asserted universal ECT cutoff. Independent reviewer must assess its suitability.

title: Oxford Health NHS ECT side effects
support: Mild headache, nausea and confusion can occur; some memory gaps persist. No incidence or guaranteed recovery time is imported.
limitations: Supports the indicated clinical facts, not independent certification of the raw item.

title: CDC U.S. MEC combined hormonal contraceptives
locator: DVT/PE without anticoagulation; migraine with aura; superficial venous disorders; breast disease
support: Idiopathic prior DVT without current anticoagulation and migraine with aura are category 4; family breast-cancer history and uncomplicated varicose veins are not those exclusions.
limitations: Supports the indicated clinical facts, not independent certification of the raw item.

title: MedlinePlus arterial blood gas test
support: pH7.35–7.45, PaCO2 35–45mmHg and ABG HCO3 22–26mEq/L agree with the repository reference-range lane.
limitations: Range owner cross-check: src/visuals/kinds/lab_trend/defs.ts ph/paco2/hco3_abg; audit/lab-reference-range-verification-2026-07-19.md S20. Arterial bicarbonate interval is distinct from chemistry bicarbonate.

title: ADA/EASD/JBDS/AACE/DTS 2024 hyperglycaemic crises consensus
locator: Diagnostic criteria; fluids; insulin/potassium; bicarbonate; resolution; special populations
support: DKA requires diabetes/hyperglycemia with ketosis and acidosis; euglycemic DKA has glucose<200mg/dL. Fluids and insulin with potassium safeguards treat DKA. Follow blood ketones and acidosis for resolution.
limitations: Same consensus co-publication: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11272983/ . Direct PMC open intermittently returned a browser challenge; primary-source indexed sections were retrievable and checked. Do not count the two publications as independent evidence.

title: ACOG Countdown to Intern Year week4: fetal heart tracings
locator: Definitions of baseline, variability, late decelerations and tachysystole
support: US-style excessive frequency is >5 contractions/10min averaged over30min; delayed slowing relative to contraction describes late decelerations.
limitations: Supports the indicated clinical facts, not independent certification of the raw item.

title: NICE NG229 fetal monitoring recommendations
support: Supports reducing/stopping oxytocin as part of response to contraction/fetal-heart concerns.
limitations: Used for action support only; do not substitute NICE’s differently worded frequency definition for the explicit US-style rule in the question.

title: US CPSC button cell and coin batteries
locator: Safety tips: compartments, damaged covers, storage
support: Accessible batteries and damaged battery compartments require protection/removal from children’s reach.
limitations: Supports the indicated clinical facts, not independent certification of the raw item.

title: American Academy of Pediatrics battery safety
support: Used/depleted batteries can remain dangerous; secure compartments and inaccessible storage matter.
limitations: Supports the indicated clinical facts, not independent certification of the raw item.

title: Scottish Palliative Care Guidelines: breathlessness
support: Supports fan/positioning and a monitored opioid trial with response/side-effect assessment.
limitations: No claim that low-dose opioids cannot cause respiratory depression; no dose imported.

title: DailyMed morphine sulfate oral solution label
locator: Boxed warning; respiratory depression and sedation
support: Opioid initiation and dose increases require attention to respiratory depression and sedation.
limitations: Label supports adverse-effect monitoring, not an on-label claim for breathlessness.

title: Surviving Sepsis Campaign 2026 adult guidelines
locator: Perfusion assessment; lactate; capillary refill; clinical diagnosis
support: Use multiple perfusion measures; capillary refill is an adjunct, and sepsis is not established/excluded by a single biomarker.
limitations: Authored trend values are scenario measurements, not new universal thresholds.

title: Repository source-verified adult lab reference lane
support: Cross-checked phosphate2.5–4.5mg/dL, K3.5–5.0mEq/L, Mg1.7–2.3mg/dL and lactate0.5–2.0mmol/L.
limitations: These explicit intervals do not imply every laboratory uses identical intervals.

title: ASPEN consensus recommendations for refeeding syndrome
locator: Definition; Table6 adult treatment and monitoring
support: Rapid phosphate/potassium/magnesium decline after caloric reintroduction supports refeeding. Replace deficits; individualize caloric reduction/cessation according to severity.
limitations: The question uses an explicit nutrition-team prescription; the producer does not assert an autonomous or universally appropriate50% PN adjustment.

title: NICE CG32 nutrition support
support: Prolonged low intake increases refeeding risk; skilled nutrition management and electrolyte monitoring/repletion are needed.
limitations: Supports the indicated clinical facts, not independent certification of the raw item.

title: NHLBI sleep apnea symptoms
support: Breathing pauses/gasping and daytime sleepiness support evaluation; symptoms alone do not substitute for diagnostic testing.
limitations: Supports the indicated clinical facts, not independent certification of the raw item.

title: MedlinePlus alcohol withdrawal
support: New severe confusion, hallucinations or seizures can indicate severe withdrawal and require urgent assessment.
limitations: Supports the indicated clinical facts, not independent certification of the raw item.

title: CDC clinical safety: hand hygiene for healthcare workers
support: Hand hygiene is required after glove/PPE removal; gloves do not replace it.
limitations: Supports the indicated clinical facts, not independent certification of the raw item.

title: CDC U.S. MEC lactational amenorrhea method
support: All required: amenorrhea, <6months postpartum and fully/nearly fully breastfeeding without intervals beyond4h by day/6h at night.
limitations: Supports the indicated clinical facts, not independent certification of the raw item.
